arxiv-2103-00828.title: The effects of large-scale magnetic fields on the model for repeating changing-look AGNs
arxiv-2103-00828.creator: Xin Pan, Shuang-Liang Li, Xinwu Cao
arxiv-2103-00828.description: Abstract Periodic outbursts are observed in several changing-look (CL) active galactic nuclei (AGNs). Sniegowska et al. 2020 suggested a model to explain the repeating CL in these AGNs, where the periodic outbursts are triggered in a narrow unstable zone between an inner ADAF and outer thin disk.

An extended abstract [ 67 ] of this work
arxiv-2103-09715.creator: Bart M. P. Jansen, Jari J. H. de Kroon, Michał Włodarczyk
arxiv-2103-09715.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bart M. P. Jansen, Jari J. H. de Kroon, Michał Włodarczyk. We study the parameterized complexity of various classic vertex-deletion problems such as Odd cycle transversal , Vertex planarization , and Chordal vertex deletion under hybrid parameterizations.

arxiv-2104-06357.title: GPU Semiring Primitives for Sparse Neighborhood Methods
arxiv-2104-06357.description: Abstract High-performance primitives for mathematical operations on sparse vectors must deal with the challenges of skewed degree distributions and limits on memory consumption that are typically not issues in dense operations. We demonstrate that a sparse semiring primitive can be flexible enough to support a wide range of critical distance measures while maintaining performance and memory efficiency on the GPU.

arxiv-2108-00812.title: Isometries of ultrametric normed spaces Thanks: Keywords: Mazur–Ulam Theorem; ultrametric normed spaces; isometries Thanks: Mathematics Subject Classification: 46S10, 26E30
arxiv-2108-00812.creator: Javier Cabello Sánchez, José Navarro Garmendia*
arxiv-2108-00812.description: Abstract . We show that the group of isometries of an ultrametric normed space can be seen as a kind of a fractal. Then, we apply this description to study ultrametric counterparts of some classical problems in Archimedean analysis, such as the so called Problème des rotations de Mazur or Tingley’s problem.

arxiv-2403-13142.title: Loops in Anti de Sitter space To Jacques Bros and Michel Gaudin. In loving memory.
arxiv-2403-13142.creator: Sergio L. Cacciatori, Henri Epstein, Ugo Moschella
arxiv-2403-13142.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sergio L. Cacciatori, Henri Epstein, Ugo Moschella. We discuss general one and two-loop banana diagrams and one-loop diagrams with external lines with arbitrary masses on the anti de Sitter spacetime by using methods of AdS quantum field theory in the dimensional regularization approach.

arxiv-2602-05670.title: HyperPotter: Spell the Charm of High-Order Interactions in Audio Deepfake Detection
arxiv-2602-05670.creator: Qing Wen, Haohao Li, Zhongjie Ba *, Peng Cheng *, Miao He, Li Lu, Kui Ren
arxiv-2602-05670.description: Abstract Advances in AIGC technologies have enabled the synthesis of highly realistic audio deepfakes capable of deceiving human auditory perception. Although numerous audio deepfake detection (ADD) methods have been developed, most rely on local temporal/spectral features or pairwise relations, overlooking high-order interactions (HOIs). HOIs capture discriminative patterns that emerge from multiple feature components beyond their individual contributions.

pmc-10507983.title: The prevalence of elongated styloid process in the population of Barcelona: a cross-sectional study & review of literature
pmc-10507983.creator: Hassan Assiri Ahmed, Albert Estrugo-Devesa, Xavier Roselló Llabrés, Sonia Egido-Moreno, José López-López
pmc-10507983.description: BackgroundStyloid process (SP) is a cylindrical bony projection that originates from the inferior part of the petrous temporal bone just anteriorly to the stylomastoid foramen. Several nerves, muscles, and ligaments are related closely to the (SP). It is considered elongated when the measurement exceeds 30 mm. The overall prevalence of the styloid process is between 3.3% to 84.4%.

pmc-11421181.title: It takes two peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors (PPAR-β/δ and PPAR-γ) to tango idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
pmc-11421181.creator: Eistine Boateng, Rocio Bonilla-Martinez, Barbara Ahlemeyer, Vannuruswamy Garikapati, Mohammad Rashedul Alam, Omelyan Trompak, Gani Oruqaj, Natalia El-Merhie, Michael Seimetz, Clemens Ruppert, Andreas Günther, Bernhard Spengler, Srikanth Karnati, Eveline Baumgart-Vogt
pmc-11421181.description: BackgroundIdiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is characterized by aberrant lung epithelial phenotypes, fibroblast activation, and increased extracellular matrix deposition. Transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-β)1-induced Smad signaling and downregulation of peroxisomal genes are involved in the pathogenesis and can be inhibited by peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR)-α activation.

pmc-11517396.title: How do health systems and health contribute to the sustainable development goals?
pmc-11517396.creator: J Cylus, L Siciliani
pmc-11517396.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). While there is considerable research and policy interest into how factors outside the health system (i.e. social determinants) influence health outcomes, there has historically been less interest in how health and health systems affect other economic and societal objectives. Such evidence can be useful to health policymakers making the case for investing in health systems to demonstrate that health systems do more than just improve health.

pmc-11672709.title: Comparative Diagnostic Efficacy of Ultrasonography and Radiography for Gas Embolism in Loggerhead (Caretta caretta) Turtles
pmc-11672709.creator: Carmela Valastro, Delia Franchini, Stefano Ciccarelli, Serena Paci, Daniela Freggi, Diego Boscia, Pasquale Salvemini, Antonio Di Bello, J Jill Heatley
pmc-11672709.description: Simple SummarySea turtles face numerous threats, many of which are linked to human activities like fishing. In the South Adriatic Sea, trawling poses a major risk, and a new threat has emerged: gas embolism (GE). This condition is increasingly diagnosed in sea turtles exposed to sudden pressure changes during fishing operations.

pmc-12369158.title: External validation of precisebreast, a digital prognostic test for predicting breast cancer recurrence, in an early-stage cohort from the Netherlands
pmc-12369158.creator: Pieter J. Westenend, Claudia Meurs, Gerardo Fernandez, Marcel Prastawa, Abishek Sainath Madduri, Aaron Feliz, Juan Carlos Mejias, Alexander Shtabsky, Xiaozhu Zhang, Brandon Veremis, Rebecca DeAngel, Michael J. Donovan
pmc-12369158.description: BackgroundCurrent clinical guidelines recommend gene expression profiling to guide treatment in early-stage breast cancer. PreciseBreast (PDxBR) is a digital prognostic tool that integrates artificial intelligence (AI)-derived features from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) slides with clinicopathologic data to predict recurrence risk. This study externally validated PDxBR in an independent cohort and compared its performance to other risk models.

pmc-12406493.title: Predictors of futile recanalization after endovascular therapy in anterior circulation stroke with large core infarction
pmc-12406493.creator: Qinhong Li, Chawen Ding, Boyu Chen, Zhenxuan Tian, Yujie Chen, Linyu Li, Nizhen Yu, Jiaxing Song, Jie Yang, Changwei Guo, Jiacheng Huang, Wenjie Zi, Zhao Yang
pmc-12406493.description: BackgroundThere is a lack of data to predict futile recanalization (FR) after endovascular treatment (EVT) in acute anterior circulation large vessel occlusion (ACLVO) with large core infarction.MethodsThis analysis included patients from a national multicenter stroke registry (November 2021 to February 2023).

pmc-12454326.title: Enhanced YOLOv8 for industrial polymer films: a semi-supervised framework for micron-scale defect detection
pmc-12454326.creator: Xiaoxia Yu, Bingyu Hu, Weifeng Jiang, Jinru Wan, Xinduoji Yang, Nianbo Liu, Xiaoyan Dong
pmc-12454326.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionPolymer material films are produced through extrusion machines, and their surfaces can develop micro-defects due to process and operational influences. The quantity and size of these defects significantly impact product quality.MethodsAs traditional machine learning defect detection methods suffer from low accuracy and poor adaptability to complex scenarios, requiring extensive effort for parameter tuning and exhibiting weak generalization capability, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv8 method to identify micro-defects on films.

pmc-12617163.title: OA2078. Protecting the most vulnerable: Findings from the ELIZA 10454 helpline in Greece in 2024
pmc-12617163.creator: E Koutsoukou, M M Dimitraki
pmc-12617163.description: BackgroundChild abuse continues to constitute a persistent and multifactorial social phenomenon on a global scale. Within this framework, the ELIZA Helpline 10454 was established to enhance the capacity of professionals who are in direct contact with children.MethodsThe Helpline aims to both identify and respond to cases of neglect or abuse.

pmc-12972769.title: Association between the sedation type and the risk of major oesophageal injury following increased intraoesophageal temperature during radiofrequency ablation for the treatment of atrial fibrillation
pmc-12972769.creator: Krzysztof Myrda, Wiktor Czarkowski, Agata Kukfisz, Bartłomiej Popielarz, Aleksandra Błachut, Krzysztof Majewski, Livio Bertagnolli, Michał Skrzypek, Mariusz Gąsior
pmc-12972769.description: BackgroundCatheter ablation (CA) has become the leading treatment option for patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). However, the use of thermal energy is still associated with the risk of specific complications, including atrio-oesophageal fistula (AEF). Several methods have been described to reduce the risk of AEF, such as adjusting the energy of a single application to limit oesophageal temperature (OT).

pmc-13172232.title: Narrative Review “Dual Frontiers in Neurodegeneration: Pharmacological Synergies and Divergences in Parkinson’s Disease and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus”
pmc-13172232.creator: Omnya A Sharallah, Vishnu Malakar, Ahmed E Salama, Salma M Elmaaz, Salma A Daba, Nitesh Kumar Poddar
pmc-13172232.description: Diabetes mellitus (DM) and Parkinson’s disease (PD) are both chronic diseases that have a bidirectional relationship, wherein DM increases the risk of developing PD. Both diseases are related through overlapping pathways, insulin resistance, oxidative stress, and chronic inflammation, which can potentially lead to neurodegeneration. Insulin resistance and impaired insulin signalling present in DM may exacerbate neurodegeneration in PD.

pmc-13247646.title: Impact of Tailored Interventions on Suicidal Ideation Recovery: Addressing Hopelessness Among Economically Vulnerable Populations During COVID-19 Period
pmc-13247646.creator: Na Yeon Kim, Doug Hyun Han, Hyunchan Hwang, Hyun Ji Lee, Sun Mi Kim
pmc-13247646.description: BackgroundPublic health crises—most recently exemplified by the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic—cause widespread psychological, social, and economic disruptions, contributing to increased depression, anxiety, and suicidal ideation rates. This study aims to examine the clinical characteristics and treatment outcomes of individuals who attempted suicide during the COVID-19 pandemic, focusing on the effectiveness of tailored interventions for economically vulnerable individuals.

pmc-13282083.title: Reevaluating Donor-recipient Sex Mismatch and Survival After Liver Transplantation: A Contemporary Cohort Study

pmc-13355291.title: Structural and Hormonal Changes Associated With Starvation in Zambian Adult Patients With Esophageal Strictures: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13355291.creator: Ellen Besa, Violet Kayamba, Victor Mudenda, Chola Mulenga, Enala Musheba, Malambo Mubbunu, Gary Frost, Paul Kelly
pmc-13355291.description: Background and AimsMalnutrition disorders are associated with an enteropathy characterized by villus blunting, secretory cell loss, and mucosal inflammation. To investigate the contribution of undernutrition to enteropathy we conducted a case–control study of adult patients with starvation due to benign esophageal strictures, compared with non‐malnourished community controls.MethodsFasting blood samples and duodenal biopsies were collected from 34 cases and 66 controls.

pmc-13368624.title: Causes and associated factors of mountain bike injuries in bike parks in western Austria: a two-season descriptive epidemiological study
pmc-13368624.creator: Gerhard Ruedl, Alois Schranz, Patrick Salner, Vera Prünster, Martin Burtscher
pmc-13368624.description: Mountain bike terrain parks have become increasingly popular, particularly at ski resorts where chairlifts transport riders uphill to enjoy downhill cycling. These parks feature trails of varying difficulty with artificial obstacles designed for jumps and stunts, which contribute to a unique pattern of injuries.

pmc-13571255.title: Modifiers of effectiveness and deterioration, and prognostic factors of adherence in internet-based interventions for treatment of perinatal depression: A systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis
pmc-13571255.creator: Marketa Ciharova, Pim Cuijpers, Mathias Harrer, Yafit Hirshler, Olga-Maria Panagiotopoulou, Lingyao Tong, Clara Miguel, Iryna Frankova, Alan W. Gemmill, Claudia Buntrock, Wouter van Ballegooijen, Ana Fonseca, Mariana Branquinho, Erik Forsell, Nicole E. Pugh, Heather D. Hadjistavropoulos, Yaoyao Sun,
pmc-13571255.description: BackgroundInternet-based interventions for perinatal depression reduce depressive symptoms in new and expectant mothers. However, modifiers of their effects, and prognostic factors of adherence, are unknown.ObjectiveTo assess modifiers of effectiveness and deterioration, and prognostic factors of adherence in internet-based interventions for perinatal depression.MethodsSystematic searches were conducted in three bibliographic databases on February 7, 2025.
